## New or changed event(s)

- [ ] Row added/edited in `events.csv`
- [ ] `status` is `approved` (merging this PR publishes it)
- [ ] `uid` is unique and never reused
- [ ] `category` exists in `categories.csv`
- [ ] Start/end are local time, format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM` (or `YYYY-MM-DD` for all-day), with the right `timezone`
- [ ] Recurring? `recurrence` has UNTIL or COUNT; skipped dates are in `exceptions`
- [ ] Source / ticket link in `url`
